description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5999015837475 SHIELDING GASKET,EL: Line 0001 Qty 189 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0021 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
